analysis: Examined docs/architecture/inference.md base lines 2034-2597 (MiMo native serving, media decode accounting, tool evidence restoration, Flash-Next, Flint constraints, Bonsai, GLM tool validation). These base-side units fall outside the changed ranges (base changes at 3, 810-811, 827; head changes at 3, 684-691, 818-821, 837, 884-903, 1740-1759), so they contain no PR-introduced text. No regression is identified in them. The integration pass should examine the head-side changes not shown here. Head 684-691 describes the GLM5Next published weight hash using the manifest aggregate, with VerifiedWeightHashStore registering a cached hash on the next coordinator-mode start without rereading weights when the device/inode/size/mtime/ctime are unchanged. This is relevant to T-012, T-027, SEC-007 and A-004: an operator controls the filesystem, so stat-tuple caching is a TOCTOU and spoofing consideration. The doc says the load verifies again before serving; confirm that reverification happens before any advertisement or routing of the cached hash. Head 818-821 describes GLM5Next video timing that is no longer restricted to a constant frame rate, which affects media admission bounds. Also review head 837, 884-903 and 1740-1759. Documentation-only evidence here; no source code was supplied.
